subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Born with silver spoon in one's mouth

options.text: To accomplish two tasks in one attempt
A work which needs tremendous energy
Born in a very rich family

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is:** 'Born in a very rich family'**
 
• **Explanation:** The idiom** "Born with a silver spoon in one's mouth"** means that the person was born into a wealthy and well-off family.(अमीर परिवार में जन्मा)
 
• The **"silver spoon"** is a metaphor for wealth.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Born in a very rich family'*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To accomplish two tasks in one attempt: **This means to achieve two goals with one action, which does not relate to the given idiom.(एक प्रयास में दो काम करना)
 
• **Useful for one's purpose:** This means something serves a beneficial purpose for someone, which is not connected to being born into wealth.(एक के उद्देश्य के लिए उपयोगी)
 
• **A work which needs tremendous energy: **This describes a task or a job that requires a lot of effort, which is not related to the concept of being born wealthy.(बहुत ऊर्जा की आवश्यकता होने वाला काम) 

38:Taec,

The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e. **'Standing between'.**
